breaker: Three review rounds without approval. Loop STOPPED and escalated to the human. No further rounds run automatically.
structural_observation: The same defect class has now returned on a new axis in every round: the declared pair list (R1/R3), the foreground binding (R13), the ground binding (O1), and now an opacity on an already-bound rule (R18) plus a sixth painter the ground audit missed (R19). Each fix was correct and each left an adjacent surface unbound. The shipped UI is NOT implicated -- the verified floors 4.88 dark / 4.57 light hold, and those pairs' grounds are correct. What keeps regenerating is the completeness of the instrument that certifies them, and the prose describing its coverage.
